message.content: [罪名]非法采伐、毁坏森林资源罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the fact: Liu directed others to cut down trees on land without logging permit. This is illegal logging. In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "非法采伐、毁坏森林资源罪" (illegal logging, destroying forest resources). Also possibly "非法占用农用地罪"? But the fact is about cutting trees without permit, which is covered by Article 322 of Criminal Law: "非法采伐、毁坏森林资源罪". So the charge is that.

Also maybe "伪造、变造森林采伐许可证"? No permit not obtained, but not forging. So only illegal logging.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法采伐、毁坏森林资源罪<eoa>
